elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Inserted clause opens "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall ...", so both expiry and any-cause termination trigger the obligations.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The insertion commits Array to "reasonable transition assistance to Ono for a period of at least ninety (90) days" — 90 days, not up to six months. To reach preferred, change the period to "up to six (6) months".

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: No pricing basis appears in the inserted paragraph; there is no "at Array's then-current rates" language (silence is not an express then-current-rates term).

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Limb (B), governed by the "Upon expiration or termination" lead-in, requires Array "within thirty (30) days, export and deliver to Ono all Data and other information belonging to, supplied by or generated for Ono that is in Array's possession or control."

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Limb (B) specifies no format; the words "commonly used, machine-readable format" are absent.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: The insertion contains no deletion obligation and no written certification of deletion following return; Section 14.2(a)(vi) only obliges Ono (not Array) to deliver or destroy Array's materials.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason" anchors both limbs to every covered exit event, not merely to anticipated expiry or to the Wind-down Period.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Limb (A): Array shall "at Ono's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Ono for a period of at least ninety (90) days" — the request condition is unrestricted as to trigger, so the 90-day floor is available after any expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Limb (B) requires export and delivery "within thirty (30) days" of the expiration/termination trigger, covering "all Data and other information belonging to, supplied by or generated for Ono" in Array's possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Duplicate check of limb (A): the period is expressed as a minimum ("at least ninety (90) days"), satisfying the fallback floor without exceeding it unnecessarily.

reasons: Fallback is position-complete: the single inserted paragraph supplies the expiry/termination trigger, a 90-day minimum assistance period running from that trigger, and a 30-day data export obligation on Array.

Preferred is not reached (period is 90 days not six months; no then-current-rates basis; no machine-readable format; no certified deletion after return), consistent with the drafter's stated fallback target.

Minimal: the clause is a concise insertion for a missing provision, deletes nothing from Article XIV, adds no survival tail, expense allocation, damages, or procedural boilerplate, and does not duplicate the existing 14.2(a)(iv) cooperation covenant (which runs only during the Wind-down Period and only toward Array).

Preserves intent: "Data" and "Ono" are defined terms, no cross-reference is broken, and Ono's existing wind-down obligations under 14.2(a)(iii), (iv), (vi) and (ix) survive without contradiction — the new duty runs the other way, on Array.

Note for the drafter (rationale only, no redline required): if pressed to preferred, the three repairs are (i) "up to six (6) months" at Array's then-current rates, (ii) "in a commonly used, machine-readable format" in limb (B), and (iii) a limb (C) requiring deletion and written certification thereafter.
